verdict.line: You lose if you let mini Gnar poke you down with Boomerang Throw and autos before 6; you win once R lets you dive him and force a premature Mega transform.

brief.thesis: Gnar has no ranged tool advantage once his Rage bar maxes and he's forced to transform — Mega Gnar trades his Boomerang Toss and Hop mobility for a melee-only kit, which is exactly the fight Malphite wants. Before level 6, Malphite has nothing but auto-range to answer Gnar's Q (Boomerang Throw, 1100 range) and his empowered third auto, so the lane is a patience check until R (Unstoppable Force) gives you a 1000-range engage onto mini Gnar.

theirWindow.what: He'll throw Q (Boomerang Throw, 16/14.5/13/11.5/10s cooldown, 1100 range) and look to land his hyper third auto from W (Hyper) for free chip. Stay outside 1100 range when you're not actively trading and don't contest CS into an open Q.

yourWindow.when: Level 6+, or Gnar forced into Mega
yourWindow.what: Use R (Unstoppable Force, 1000 range) to charge onto mini Gnar and knock him up, then follow with E (Ground Slam) to cut his attack speed and W (Brutal Strikes) for the armor/AD buff. Once he's Mega Gnar his E only smashes in place instead of hopping away, so all-in freely.

start.why: Sustain through Gnar's poke harass and extra mana for trading Q (Seismic Shard) more often early — the 58.3% win rate pick over 360 games.

boots.why: Flat reduction on his third empowered auto and basic attack chip, which is the bulk of his pre-6 damage — 56.2% win rate, 76.1% pick.

core.why: Builds the armor your E (Ground Slam) damage scales off while adding AoE burn for wave control.

runes.keystoneWhy: Punishes Gnar every time he commits a Q (Boomerang Throw) or steps up to auto, since the proc rewards you for poking back on his cooldown.

summoners.why: Teleport resets you after shoving the wave with Sunfire's burn, and Flash is what secures your R engage or bails you out of a bad poke exchange — the 56.2% win rate, 71.6% pick combo.

playing.title: Farm from auto range only
playing.detail: Don't step inside Boomerang Throw's 1100 range to contest CS before level 6 — let minions soak the poke instead of you.

playing.title: Track his Rage bar
playing.detail: When Gnar's Rage nears max, his next ability use transforms him into Mega Gnar, stripping his ranged Q and Hop mobility — that's your cue to commit.

playing.title: Lead engages with R, not Q
playing.detail: Seismic Shard (8s cooldown, 625 range) alone won't catch a kiting Gnar — use R (Unstoppable Force) first to close the gap, then Q to finish slowing him.

playing.title: Pop W before extended trades
playing.detail: Activate Brutal Strikes before a fight starts so the armor and attack damage buff is live when his autos land.

playing.title: Punish his Hyper window
playing.detail: After Gnar uses W (Hyper) for the move speed burst, step up — his follow-up damage window is open and his cooldown (7s) is down.

playing.title: Threaten R in teamfights
playing.detail: Once R is off cooldown, look to knock Gnar into your team — this is especially punishing if he's already Mega and has lost Hop's escape.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, runes, summoners, and all win rates/sample sizes above are measured from live games on the current patch (16.20.1); the mechanical reasoning and trade patterns are my own tactical read, not scraped data.
